metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in California higher than in Mississippi during July 12-19, 2005?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS LST (Terra) - MOD11A1.061 (daily, 1km resolution) - Date: July 12-19, 2005 - Location: California and Mississippi state boundaries 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for LST (use QA flags if available) - Focus on valid LST measurements 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: LST values in valid range (typically 7500-65535 in raw units, convert to Celsius) - C1: No images found for either state - C2: No valid pixels after filtering - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid temperature - A: California LST > Mississippi LST - B: California LST <= Mississippi LST ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const california = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'California')) .geometry(); const mississippi = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Mississippi')) .geometry(); const startDate = '2005-07-12'; const endDate = '2005-07-20'; // 2. Data Acquisition const lstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const caCollection = lstCollection.filterBounds(california); const msCollection = lstCollection.filterBounds(mississippi); const caSize = caCollection.size().getInfo(); const msSize = msCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`California images: ${caSize}`); console.log(`Mississippi images: ${msSize}`); if (caSize === 0 || msSize === 0) { console.log("No data found for one or both states."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites const caMean = caCollection.mean(); const msMean = msCollection.mean(); // Convert from Kelvin*50 to Celsius const caLST = caMean.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); const msLST = msMean.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // 4. Calculate mean temperatures with pixel count const caStats = caLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: california, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const msStats = msLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: mississippi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const caTempMean = caStats.LST_Day_1km_mean; const caTempCount = caStats.LST_Day_1km_count; const msTempMean = msStats.LST_Day_1km_mean; const msTempCount = msStats.LST_Day_1km_count; console.log(`CA: Temp=${caTempMean}°C, Pixels=${caTempCount}`); console.log(`MS: Temp=${msTempMean}°C, Pixels=${msTempCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (caTempCount === 0 || msTempCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (caTempMean === null || msTempMean === null || isNaN(caTempMean) || isNaN(msTempMean) || caTempMean < -50 || caTempMean > 70 || msTempMean < -50 || msTempMean > 70) { console.log("Invalid temperature calculation."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (caTempMean > msTempMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
